blocks.text: Montmartre is the highest point in Paris, once home to Picasso, Renoir, and Toulouse-Lautrec, and still dotted with artists' easels around the Place du Tertre.
I arrived early to beat the crowds at the white-domed Basilica of Sacre-Coeur, then wandered the steep, cobbled streets down toward the old Moulin Rouge windmill.
